title: "Sample-Based Area Estimation (SBAE)"

::: {.hero}
## A living guide to sample-based area estimation

This whitepaper brings together guidance on designing and implementing sample-based area estimation for forest monitoring, including degradation, reforestation and afforestation. It is updated as methods, imagery and country experience evolve.
